scope: Only Start cancellation cleanup before returning no Process handle; not whole S2/coordinator/crash recovery or LIVE.

observations: The independent test cancels inside BeforeResume while holding the callback open for 60ms; Start does not return prematurely.
After the callback is released, Start returns nil/context.Canceled within the bound.
A host-pinned process handle is already signalled, the exact owned staging path queried from that process is already removed, and no child output was ever emitted.

limits: Callbacks remain trusted host code required to return; an indefinitely stuck callback has no demonstrated forced-unwind mechanism. Waiting for owned cleanup intentionally prevents returning an unobservable still-running process.
Only two fresh no-secret native fixtures were launched; no production process, database or provider was accessed.
This focused change does not accept the pending full runtime S2 coordinator, checkpoint/resume or crash matrix.
